_comment: Golden end-to-end fixture for harness/predict.py. Each id is a WBM CALIBRATION structure; e_above_hull_mev and e_mace are what the calibration run recorded for it at settings tag c2480e74 (MACE-MPA-0 medium, cpu/float32), and label is the label the frozen calibration bundle gives that recorded prediction. predict_structure() on the same WBM initial structure must reproduce both. Regenerate only when the calibration run itself is redone.
